prerequisites.title: Developer account, project and app
prerequisites.detail: You need an X developer account, a Project in the developer portal, and an App holding the API credentials.

prerequisites.title: OAuth 2.0 enabled on the app
prerequisites.detail: Turn on OAuth 2.0 in the app's authentication settings.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and terms of service
prerequisites.detail: Link both in the developer dashboard before requesting write or DM scopes.

steps.title: Create developer account, project and app
steps.detail: Sign up for X developer access, create a Project, then an App.
steps.done_when: You have an App with client ID and secret.

steps.title: Enable OAuth 2.0 in app settings
steps.detail: Turn on OAuth 2.0 in the app's authentication settings.

steps.title: Draft scope justifications
steps.detail: Write a clear reason for each requested scope, such as posting tweets. Include offline.access if you need refresh tokens.
steps.done_when: Each scope has a written justification.

steps.title: Link privacy policy and terms
steps.detail: Add both documents in the developer dashboard.
steps.done_when: Both links appear in the dashboard.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and shows a redirect URI.

steps.title: Register callback URL in X app
steps.detail: Paste the exact Composio redirect URI into the app settings. It must use HTTPS and match exactly.
steps.done_when: A test connection returns without a callback error.

steps.title: Wait for security review if triggered
steps.detail: Write or DM scopes may trigger a security review. No duration is documented.
steps.done_when: Outside users can authorize with write scopes.

traps.title: Callback URL must match exactly
traps.detail: Protocol, slashes and trailing slash all count, and localhost differs from 127.0.0.1. Production callbacks must use HTTPS.

traps.title: Access tokens die after about 2 hours
traps.detail: Without the offline.access scope there is no refresh token. Request it in the first authorization.

traps.title: Regenerating the client secret breaks refresh
traps.detail: A client secret regenerated in the developer portal can make token refresh fail. Update the Composio auth config if you rotate it.

traps.title: Request minimal scopes first
traps.detail: A blog recommends starting read-only and expanding later. Write and DM scopes are the ones linked to security review.

traps.title: Consent screen shows Composio on managed apps
traps.detail: In production users should see your app name, not Composio, which is another reason to use your own app.

blockers.what_to_do: Apply for Elevated access or re-check the requested permissions.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare requested scopes against what you actually need.

blockers.what_it_means: The redirect URL is not in the app settings, or does not match exactly.

blockers.symptom: A pending security review for write or DM scopes
blockers.what_it_means: The app may be under review because of its scopes.
blockers.what_to_do: Make sure policies are linked and scope reasons are clear.
